About the author

Written by a machinist

Tim Blakely has run FANUC-controlled CNC machines since 2009, working his way from operator to the programmer other machinists bring their hardest jobs to. He's self-taught in macros and parameters, and everything he writes comes off a real control on a real shop floor in North Carolina.
